shortBulletSummary: Bitcoin consolidates near $77K after a strong rally, with some analysts eyeing targets up to $89K.
US Bitcoin and Ethereum ETFs recorded their strongest weekly inflows of 2026, totaling $2.6 billion.
US Treasury bond buybacks are injecting liquidity, supporting speculative assets like crypto as yields fall.
Rising US-Iran tensions and new sanctions are adding geopolitical risk to markets, potentially impacting oil prices.
